**Motif:** This is an **attraction** (also called deflection when pulling the king)—Black sacrifices the rook by checking from h8, forcing White's rook to h5 to block, where it's captured with checkmate. The White king is trapped on h3 with no escape squares.

**Best move:** Rh8+

**Main line:** Rh8+ Rh5 Rxh5#

**Coaching note:**
When your opponent's king is trapped in the corner with few escape squares, look for forcing checks that pull their defending pieces into bad positions. Here, Black's rook check on h8 forces White's rook to block on h5—directly into the line of fire. The king on h3 can't escape, so after White blocks, Black captures with checkmate. Always calculate forcing moves deeply, especially when the opponent's king looks vulnerable.
